breadcrumbs.name: Brand Protection RFID Solutions — NFC Authentication & Anti-counterfeit Tags

summary: NFC authentication tags with NTAG424 DNA provide cryptographic proof of product authenticity — protecting footwear, luxury fashion, cosmetics, wine and spirits from counterfeiting. Each tap generates a unique, unclonable verification code that consumers verify with any smartphone.
